# The drafts the back end starts with

The back end opens with a set of drafts in **Plans**, so the area does not start empty. These are the same drafts, as files, so they can be read here.

Once the back end has been used, [Plans](https://quickpickle.co.nz/backstage/plans) is where the working copy lives. A sheet that has been changed there, or a question that has been answered there, is not changed here.

Everything was written for a New Zealand business selling a packaged food online. Only what was known on 12 November 2026 is stated as fact. The rest is a question to answer, a blank to fill in (`____`), or an assumption marked as one.

## Lists

- [Questions only a person can answer](QUESTIONS.md): 47 of them, by topic.
- [The compliance checklist](COMPLIANCE.md): 29 things to look into. Not legal advice.
- [What a pack costs to make and send](COSTS.md): the 17 lines of the budget.

## How-to sheets

Checklists to follow on the day.

- [How to pack an order](how-to/how-to-pack-an-order.md): From the packing queue to the courier, one order at a time.
- [How to change a price, a date or delivery, and how to stop taking orders](how-to/how-to-change-the-shop.md): What a pack costs, what delivery costs, when a pre-order ships, and the switch that stops orders. All changed in one place, with nobody else needed.
- [How to run a production day](how-to/how-to-production-day.md): What to prepare and what to write in the batch record. The food-safety steps are blanks to fill from your food plan.
- [What to do when an order arrives damaged or goes missing](how-to/how-to-damaged-or-missing-order.md): A customer says their order arrived damaged, leaking, wrong, or not at all.
- [How to handle a complaint](how-to/how-to-complaint.md): A customer is unhappy with the product itself: how it tasted, looked or smelled, or they felt unwell.
- [What to do when a card payment is disputed](how-to/how-to-card-dispute.md): A customer's bank has taken a payment back and given the shop a date to answer by.
- [How to recall a batch](how-to/how-to-recall.md): Who to tell, in what order, and what to keep, when a batch has to come back.
- [How to answer a health question](how-to/how-to-answer-a-health-question.md): The one safe reply when someone asks what it does for their body, or tells us what it did.
- [What to hand to Xero and the accountant at month end](how-to/how-to-month-end.md): The month-end routine: what to pull out of the back end and what goes to Xero and your accountant.
- [The weekly check](how-to/how-to-weekly-check.md): A once-a-week run through orders, stock, customers, money and the plan, from your phone.
- [How to email the Pickle Crew](how-to/how-to-email-the-pickle-crew.md): Writing a campaign, reading it, sending it, and what to do when somebody wants off the list or an email comes back.
- [How to connect Claude, and what it can do for you](how-to/how-to-work-with-claude.md): Connecting your own Claude to the back end, what it may do by itself, and how you say yes to the rest.

## Plans

Where the business is going and how. Drafts, with blanks to fill.

- [Business plan](plans/business-plan.md): What we sell and to whom, what has to be true for it to work, the first 90 days and the risks.
- [Marketing plan](plans/marketing-plan.md): Who it is for (to test), what we are allowed to say, the first channels, a 12-week calendar and the rules.
- [Launch checklist](plans/launch-checklist.md): Every step from here to the first real order at a customer's door, in order.

## Policies

The rules the business holds itself to.

- [Reviews: what we publish and what we do not](policies/policy-reviews.md): Every review is read by a person first. Taste, the bottle and Lucky go up. Anything about a body does not.
- [Naming people, clubs and partners](policies/policy-naming-people.md): Nobody is named, quoted, tagged or pictured without written permission on file.
